parameters.content:
## Route tickets by team (Route by Choice)

Each route becomes an **output** of the Jev node. The last output, **Low Confidence**, receives tickets Jev is unsure about (confidence < 0.7), such as a ticket that fits more than one team.

Every item carries `jev.route`, `jev.confidence` and `jev.probabilities`.

Replace the No-Op nodes with your helpdesk actions (assign group, post to Slack, ...).

Select your **Jev credential** on the Jev node, then click **Execute workflow**.
